messages:
deploy-bot: initiating release wave now: api@v2.3.1, runtime@v4.7, console@v1.9.0, router@v3.0.2. Change window 2025-06-15 23:00->2025-06-16 03:00 UTC. Canary set to 2% traffic in us-west1. Pins: runtime -> v4.7-rc2, router -> v3.0.2-canary. Rollback triggers: 1% error rate OR latency p95 > 500ms for 5m. Please ack and call out any cross-service blockers.
maria: acked. I'm go/no-go for runtime pin but need confirmation on kv-eviction behavior in v4.7-rc2. We saw a regression in staging earlier.
jess: api team - no schema changes. We depend on new runtime kv behavior for prefix caching; can we confirm eviction window won't clear live prefix keys during canary?
kyle: runtime here. rc2 fixes an allocation bug but the kv eviction TTL default changed from 30s->15s in this build (we thought it was safe). We can override with config: RUNTIME_KV_TTL=30s per deployment. Recommend setting that for canary.
sam: console: deploying dashboard panels post-cutover. If runtime TTL is 15s we'll see cache churn in the console metrics collection. Prefer we keep TTL=30s for first 30m of canary then evaluate.
oncall-sre: noticed a minor spike in tokenization latency in earlier tests, not visible in prod. We'll watch p95 and 99. If we exceed rollback thresholds once, we should do an automated traffic cutback to 0% then manual review.
maria: action: kyle can you push an override to the canary runtime pool? simple helm value or env var?
kyle: pushed RU: runtime-canary: set RUNTIME_KV_TTL: "30s" to the canary config. Command I ran: ```kubectl -n runtime rollout restart sts/runtime-canary && kubectl set env sts/runtime-canary RUNTIME_KV_TTL=30s``` verify with `kubectl -n runtime get pods -l app=runtime-canary -o wide`
jess: thanks. api will keep canary routing at 2%. I'll prepare a short smoke set: 5 quick prompts covering prefix cache, long-sequence, and reranking. Posting here in 5.
maria: release notes - please call out: runtime kv-ttl override and router header-swap change. Also note console metrics may show transient cache misses. Add rollback guide: commands to pin previous versions.
sam: console ops: noted. We'll delay panel refreshes until runtime is steady for 10m. Also tagging dashboards with `release/1761112222` for quick filter.
oncall-sre: confirm alerting: I updated the alert runbook to add fast rollback play: if errors>1% for 3m escalate to pager, auto-cut to fallback model after 5m. Also added a slack webhook that posts to #incidents.
maria: small ask - can deploy-bot include the commit SHAs for each component in the notification? helps tie to changelogs.
deploy-bot: updated message with SHAs: api@v2.3.1 -> sha: a1b2c3d, runtime@v4.7-rc2 -> sha: f9e8d7c, console@v1.9.0 -> sha: 0f1e2d3, router@v3.0.2 -> sha: c3b2a1f. Re-running canary in 2m.
jess: smoke tests queued: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.internal/reply -d '{"prompt":"prefix cache test"}' | jq .``` will run 100 reqs at 2rps across 10 seeds.
kyle: runtime pod logs look healthy after TTL override. tail: `2025-06-15T23:02:11Z INFO kv: ttl set=30s` no recoverable errors.
oncall-sre: watching metrics now. if p95 crosses 500ms or error% >0.5% in next 10m call immediate hold.
maria: thumbs up. I'll assemble release note snippet and push to the release-notes repo: - kv-ttl override - router header-swap map - pinned runtime & router versions - canary 2% for 30m then evaluate.
sam: tagging console PR with the release note and hold until ok from runtime.
jess: if canary passes 30m with no regressions we'll increment traffic to 10% and schedule full rollout in 2h. Keep rollback playbook on hand.
maria: final: everyone ok with rollback criteria as written? error rate >1% OR p95>500ms for 5m -> immediate cut to fallback and notify oncall.
oncall-sre: ok. I will watch and can execute cutback commands if needed. Posting quick rollback commands here:
```
# cut traffic to fallback
kubectl -n routing exec deploy/router-controller -- /bin/sh -c "./routectl set-weight api-v2 --traffic 0 && ./routectl set-weight api-fallback --traffic 100"
# pin runtime back
kubectl -n runtime set image sts/runtime-prod runtime=runtime:4.6.9
```
maria: perfect. thanks team. I'll close this thread when we reach 10% ramp or rollback.
